purpose: Test a value hypothesis and first-use clarity without collecting sensitive personal content or recruiting before consent review.
consentBoundary: Participation is voluntary and may stop at any time.
Do not request customer identifiers, contact details, private conversations, health details, financial details, legal matters, images, or other sensitive information.
Do not compensate positive feedback, app opens, referrals, or conversion.
Store only an approved aggregate research synthesis; do not place raw responses in the portable framework or a shared learning export.
questions: What first value did you expect from this invitation?
Which wording felt specific, useful, or unclear?
What would make this experience meaningfully different from a general AI tool?
Which claim would you want the product to prove before you trust it?
What would make you return after a first useful action?
Where would you expect consent, control, or an opt-out choice?
What would make you stop using the product after one try?
What should the product avoid claiming or asking from a user?
analysisOutput: aggregate JTBD themes, objections, and internal product or content tickets without identifiers
